questions.prompt: Which learning objective is most directly associated with “Using Pandas with Visualization Libraries”?

questions.prompt: What is the most reliable way to check work involving using pandas with visualization libraries?

questions.explanation: Validation makes the expected data shape and behavior explicit. Check the fields and edge cases that affect this operation before treating the result as trustworthy.
